question: Who are identified as the independent impellers of the lineage across the four ages?
premises: The four ages are invoked as a designation.
They are impellers of the family or lineage.
inference: Independent lineage-impellers operate across the four ages.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of caturyuga to the rest is elliptical.
plain_english: O Lord of gods, thus are the independent impellers of the lineage across the four ages.
